info.name: GeoAnnotator API
info.description: Every endpoint of GeoAnnotator. Select the "GeoAnnotator – Local" environment, then run the folders from top to bottom: ids (projectId, taskId…) are remembered in collection variables.

item.name: Patch 01 · Health
item.description: Is the server running? No login needed.

request.description:
Returns { status: 'ok', database: 'ok', time } when the API is up and can reach PostgreSQL.
Returns 503 { status: 'error', database: 'unreachable' } when the database is down (try: docker compose stop db).

Who can call it: anyone.
Used by: nothing on screen yet. Later, Docker uses it to check that the backend is healthy.
A URL with no route. The server answers 404 with a JSON error instead of an HTML page.

item.name: Patch 03 · Auth
item.description:
Login, logout and 'who am I?'. Run the folder from top to bottom: it starts logged out, tries the failure cases, logs in, and logs out again.

The login cookie is stored by Postman automatically (see 'Cookies' under the Send button), just like a browser does.

request.description:
Deletes the session cookie. Always answers 204 No Content, even when you were not logged in.

Used by: the Logout button (patch 06).

Returns { user: { id, name, email, role } } for the logged-in user, or 401 { error: 'Please log in' }.

Who can call it: anyone; only a valid session cookie gets a 200.
Used by: the frontend when a page loads, to know who is logged in and which portal to show (patch 06).

exec: pm.test('Error says "Please log in"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Please log in'));

request.description: The body has no email and no password. Zod rejects it: 400, with `error` (the first problem, for a toast) and `issues` (every problem, one per field, for a form).

exec: pm.test('Error says "Enter your email"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Enter your email'));
pm.test('Lists both missing fields', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().issues.map(i => i.field)).to.eql(['email', 'password']));

request.description: The email is not a valid address.

exec: pm.test('Error says "Enter a valid email address"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Enter a valid email address'));

request.description:
The email exists but the password is wrong. Note the message: it does not say which one was wrong.

Every failed login counts towards the limit of 20 per 15 minutes; after that you get 429.

exec: pm.test('Error says "Invalid email or password"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));

request.description: No account has this email. The answer is exactly the same as for a wrong password, so nobody can discover which emails have an account.

exec: pm.test('Error says "Invalid email or password"', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));

request.description:
Correct email and password (from the environment variables adminEmail / adminPassword, which match ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env).

Returns { user: { id, name, email, role } } and a Set-Cookie header with the session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax).

Who can call it: anyone.
Used by: the Sign In button on the login screen (patch 06).

Returns { user: { id, name, email, role } } for the logged-in user, or 401 { error: 'Please log in' }.

Who can call it: anyone; only a valid session cookie gets a 200.
Used by: the frontend when a page loads, to know who is logged in and which portal to show (patch 06).

Deletes the session cookie (the response sets it to an empty value that expired in 1970).

Used by: the Logout button (patch 06).

item.name: Admin · Users and groups
item.description: Admin only. Log in as admin first (folder "Patch 03 · Auth").

request.description: The session cookie now belongs to the admin.
Also remembers the demo annotator and auditor ids for the task requests.

item.name: Admin · Imagery
item.description: In "Upload images", click the files row in the Body tab and choose a .tif or .tiff image from your computer.

request.description: Only TIFF / GeoTIFF files (.tif, .tiff) are accepted; anything else (or a renamed JPEG) → 400.

item.name: List project images (status UPLOADED → PROCESSING → READY)
Annotator · Work on a task
item.description: Run "Admin · Tasks" first. These requests log in as the demo annotator.

request.description: The session cookie now belongs to the annotator.
Pixel coordinates: x to the right, y down. PostGIS cuts the shape to the image and checks it. A segmentation project only takes polygons (drawn, from the magic pen or the brush).

item.name: A polygon inside the first one → 400
A rotated box in a segmentation project → 400

request.description: Rotated boxes (OBB: 4 corners, first side = angle) belong to object detection projects. Segmentation only uses polygons.

item.name: Magic pen: the object under a pixel

request.description: Grows a region of similar colour from (x, y) inside `view` (the part of the image on screen) and returns its outline as a polygon. tolerance: 1-128 per colour channel. Nothing is saved: the editor then saves the polygon with "Draw a polygon". 400 when nothing stands out at that pixel (or everything does).

exec: pm.test('Status 200, or 400 when nothing stands out at this pixel', () => pm.expect([200, 400]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Brush: a stroke becomes a polygon

request.description: The stroke (the path of the brush centre) is widened by `radius` pixels. With `base` (the selected polygon) it is added to it, or erased from it with "erase": true. Answers { action: create | update | delete | none, geometry }. Nothing is saved.

item.name: Cut: split a polygon along a line

request.description: The line must cross the polygon from outside to outside. Answers { pieces: [polygon, …] }, largest first; the editor keeps the first as the shape and saves the others as new shapes. Nothing is saved here.
Shapes that touch or overlap become one polygon (400 when they are apart). Nothing is saved here.
The session cookie now belongs to the auditor.

item.name: Approve all shapes of the image
Auditor · Other verdicts (instead of Pass)
item.description: Use these on a submitted task instead of "Pass the whole task". After a pass they answer 409.

request.description: When every image has a verdict, the task passes or fails by itself.

item.name: Fail the whole task (needs a reason)
Admin · Export
item.description: Log in as admin again first. Only tasks that passed review are exported (the auditor folder passes the task). In Postman use "Send and Download" to save the zip.

request.description: The session cookie now belongs to the admin.
passedTaskCount, imageCount and labelCount of the tasks that passed review.

item.name: Download masks, a folder per class (512 px chips)

request.description: Segmentation projects always export masks (format can be left out). images/ + masks/<class>/<chip>.png (the class white, everything else black) + classes.txt (id and name).

item.name: Download masks, merged, with augmentation (custom 800 px chips)

request.description: masks/<chip>.png: black background, each class in its own colour. augmentCopies=2 adds <chip>_aug1/_aug2 with the chosen geometric (FLIP_H, FLIP_V, ROTATE_90, ROTATE, ZOOM) and colour (BRIGHTNESS, CONTRAST, SATURATION, HUE, BLUR, SHARPEN, NOISE, GRAYSCALE) augmentations; masks move with the image.

item.name: A detection format in a segmentation project → 400

request.description: Object detection projects export format=YOLO_OBB or format=VOC (Pascal VOC XML); segmentation only masks.
Chips are 64 to 10000 px (or 0 for whole images).
